description: This Java class 'AIMPaymentServices' provides integration with the Authorize.Net AIM payment gateway, including methods for authorization, capture, refund, release, and transaction processing, with handling for different response codes and transaction types.

classes.name: AIMPaymentServices
classes.description: A Java class providing methods to interact with Authorize.Net AIM payment gateway, including authorization, capture, refund, release, and transaction validation.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs an authorization transaction with the payment gateway.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized transaction.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a previous transaction, with logic to void the authorization if refund fails.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Releases (voids) an authorized transaction.

methods.name: ccCredit
methods.description: Unsupported operation, returns error indicating credit is unsupported.

methods.name: ccAuthCapture
methods.description: Performs an authorization and capture in a single transaction.

methods.name: processCard
methods.description: Handles the HTTP communication with the payment gateway for a transaction.

methods.name: buildAIMProperties
methods.description: Builds configuration properties for the payment gateway connection.

methods.name: buildMerchantInfo
methods.description: Prepares merchant credentials for the transaction request.

methods.name: buildGatewayResponeConfig
methods.description: Configures response format settings for the transaction request.

methods.name: buildCustomerBillingInfo
methods.description: Adds billing information to the transaction request.

methods.name: buildEmailSettings
methods.description: Adds email notification settings to the request.

methods.name: buildInvoiceInfo
methods.description: Adds invoice and description details to the request.

methods.name: buildAuthTransaction
methods.description: Constructs the authorization transaction data.

methods.name: buildCaptureTransaction
methods.description: Constructs the capture transaction data.

methods.name: buildRefundTransaction
methods.description: Constructs the refund transaction data.

methods.name: buildVoidTransaction
methods.description: Constructs the void transaction data.

methods.name: validateRequest
methods.description: Validates the transaction request before sending.

methods.name: processAuthTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response of an authorization transaction.

methods.name: processCaptureTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response of a capture transaction.

methods.name: processRefundTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response of a refund transaction.

methods.name: processReleaseTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response of a release (void) transaction.

methods.name: processAuthCaptureTransResult
methods.description: Processes the combined auth and capture transaction response.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for the payment gateway.

methods.name: getCardType
methods.description: Converts internal card type to gateway-specific code.

methods.name: getXAmount
methods.description: Extracts the amount from the request map.

methods.name: isVoidableResponse
methods.description: Checks if a response code indicates a voidable transaction.

methods.name: isTestMode
methods.description: Determines if the current environment is test mode based on properties.
